presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 the exploded plan (band above the room) plus the panel cannot hold five near-maximum cards, four relationships with near-maximum captions, four participants and two exhibits: every composition left the people at 34-49 px or a caption without a place beside its own line. Tried before capping (1:1, 22.5 down to 16.4 px): text column 0.24-0.32 and band 2-3 columns; band shares 0.24-0.42; extra floor under the table (0, 140, 280 units); cabinet first or last in the band; room width searched 680-2600; caption offsets 10-64 px at nine places along each line; shorter item texts alone (people 48.9 px); three relationships alone (people 33.9 px). Rendered BEFORE (capmeasure, hold): 16:9 17.1 px / 69.7 px, 9:16 16.4 / 106.1, 1:1 16.4 / 33.8 (people-small). AFTER the cap (item texts 34-42 characters, 5 -> 4 items, 4 -> 3 relationships; participant labels 38-41 characters): 16:9 19.8 / 74.9, 9:16 22.5 / 76.0, 1:1 16.4 / 63.0. Counts stay >= baseline (4 participants vs 3, 4 items vs 3, 3 relationships vs 3, 2 exhibits vs 1); element labels and relation captions keep their near-maximum lengths.
